tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (tha)༄༅/ /grub chen thang rgyal lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i ma ṇi ril sgrub gzhan phan kun khyab ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /na mo gu ru lo ke sha
(tha)༄༅/ /grub chen thang rgyal lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i ma ṇi ril sgrub gzhan phan kun khyab ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /na mo gu ru lo ke sha

tei:div.tei:p: (tha)༄༅// grub chen thang rgyal lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i ma ṇi ril sgrub gzhan phan kun khyab ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru lo ke shwa rā ya/ 'dir 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po bzhi brtsegs kyi sgo nas ril sgrub bya ba la gnyis/ sngon du bum pa sgrub pa dang*/ dngos gzhi ril bu sgrub pa'o// dang po la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las dang po ni/ mdun stegs kyi khar bum pa lnga tshan lnga'i bcud kyis gtams pa kha rgyan mgul chings dung chos gzungs rdor bcas dang*/ de'i mthar chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dang gtor ma gsum bsham/ gzhan rdor dril sogs nyer mkho tshogs par byas nas/ rang nyid khrus gtsang sbras stan bde bar 'khod do// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ rang gi mdun du sems can thams cad snying khong rus pa'i gting nas skyabs su 'gro bar bsams la skyabs 'gro bya ba ni/ pha mas gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas la= chos la= dge 'dun la= 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la= mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes lan gsum dang*/ sangs rgyas chos dang sogs/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// shes rab snying rje dang bcas pa'i// brtson pas sems can don du bdag /sangs rgyas drung du gnas bcas nas// rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed bgyi// dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sogs/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i phyir du bdag gis 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i sgrub pa nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// bdag bskyed ni/

oṃ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi lte bar thugs rje chen po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon ut+pal dkar po snyan gyi thad dkar kha bye ba'i yu ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal 'dzum dang bcas pa'o// snying gar thugs rje chen po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa bzhengs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na shel gyi phreng ba bsnams pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na pad+ma dkar po bsnams pa/ mgrin par bcu gcig zhal rtsa ba'i zhal dbus dkar/ g.yas ljang*/ g.yon dmar ba/ de'i steng ma gsum dbus ljang*/ g.yas dmar/ g.yon dkar ba/ de'i steng ma gsum dbus dmar/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon ljang ba/ de rnams 'dzum pa'i nyams can/ dbu skra bsil ba/ de'i steng du khro zhal nag po mche ba gtsigs pa khro gnyer dang ldan pa spyan gsum pa/ ral pa dmar ser gyen du sgreng ba/ de'i spyi bor 'od dpag med kyi zhal dmar po gtsug tor dang bcas pa/ rgyan spangs pa tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ 'dzum pa mgul pa dang bcas pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi gnyis pas bgrang phreng*/ gsum pas mchog sbyin/ bzhi pas 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pas gser gyi pad+ma yu ba dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ gsum pas ril ba spyi blugs/ bzhi pas mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ spyi bor 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug phyag stong spyan stong dang ldan pa bzhengs pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dbus dkar/ g.yas ljang g.yon dmar ba/ de'i steng ma gsum dbus ljang*/ g.yas dmar/ g.yon dkar ba/ de rnams zhi zhal 'dzum pa'i nyams can/ dbu skra sil bu/ de'i steng du khro zhal dmar po gnyis gshibs/ de'i steng du khro zhal nag po gnyis gshibs/ mche ba gtsigs shing khro gnyer dang bcas pa spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ ral pa dmar ser gyen du bsgrengs pa/

de'i steng du 'od dpag med zhi zhal dmar po gtsug tor dang bcas pa/ rgyan spangs pa tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ 'dzum pa mgul pa dang bcas pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi gnyis pas bgrang phreng*/ gsum pas mchog sbyin/ bzhi pas 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pas gser gyi pad+ma yu ba dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ gsum pas ril ba spyi blugs/ bzhi pas mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ phyag lhag ma dgu brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa gnyis pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar 'jam zhing mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ phyag thams cad kyi mthil na spyan re re yod pa/ phyag rnams yar dbu'i gtsug tor dang*/ mar pus mo'i lha nga las mi 'da' ba/ bzhi ka'ang ri dwags kyi pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ sku stod la ras dkar po dang*/ sku smad la ras sna tshogs pas sham thabs rol par 'chang ba/ nor bus spras pa'i gser gyi ska rags bcings pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa'o// lha rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hrīḥde las 'od zer 'phros pas lho phyogs po ta la la sogs te zhing khams rab 'byams nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thugs rje chen po bzhi brtsegs kyi rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas ye shes pa spyan drangs la/ lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra sngon du 'gro bas ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs kyis bstod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang lte ba'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rgyal ba rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ chos sku nam mkhas bstod/ bdag bskyed kyi lha la mngon par dbang bskur bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rigs lnga'i thugs ka nas yum sangs rgyas spyan ma/

mā ma kī/ gos dkar mo/ sgrol ma bzhis bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs te/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// zhes sh+lo ka gcig dang*/ oṃ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar rdo rje sems dpa'/ rna ba g.yas par rin chen 'byung ldan/ ltag par rnam par snang mdzad/ rna ba g.yon par don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ rang gi rnam smin gyi lus sbyangs/ sems thugs rje chen po bzhi'i ngo bor gyur/ bdag bskyed kyi lha'i yig 'bru rnams klog pa'i tshul du bzlas pas/ yig 'bru rnams las 'od 'phros snod kyi 'jig rten la phog po ta lar gyur/ bcud kyi sems can la phog sdig sgrib sbyangs nas thugs rje chen po bzhi'i ngo bor gyur par bsam/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ bcu gcig zhal gyi thugs kar pad zla'i steng du/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥ.ār+ya dz+nyā na sā ga ra bai ro tsa na byū ha rā dzā ya/ zhes sogs gzungs ring gcig gis mgo byas la gzungs thung nyi shu rtsa gcig 'dren no// phyag stong spyan stong gi thugs kar pad zla'i steng du gzungs ring nyer gcig byed/ mchod pa ni/ oṃ ār+ya a ba lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri bā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs sh+lo ka gcig jo bo thugs rje chen pos bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bcos ma ma yin pa rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de nas bum pa sgrub pa ni/ mchod pa a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/

zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che las grub pa'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ dpag bsam shing gis kha brgyan pa/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ nang chu dang bcud kyis yongs su gang ba'i pad zla'i steng du dbus su 'od dpag med/ shar du rdo rje sems dpa'/ lhor rin chen 'byung ldan/ nub tu rnam par snang mdzad/ byang du don yod grub pa/ de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du sogs kyis bstod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pa nas/ yar lud pa las/ bar gong ltar la bdag mdun gyi tshig bsgyur/ rigs lnga la rigs lnga so sos dbu brgyan/ mchod bstod gong ltar/ gzungs thag nas bzung la/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi sogs spyi ltar dmigs pa rtse gcig pas/ ma ṇi gtso bor gyur pa'i gzungs ring thung dang rigs lnga'i snying po rnams bzla/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'phags pa ye shes rgya mtsho rnam par snang mdzad bkod pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod yon dam pa 'di dag dang*// 'jig rten khams kyi mchod yon rnams// thams cad blo yis blangs nas ni// bcom ldan bum pa'i lha la 'bul// oṃ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/

'gre'o// chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*// zhes pa dang*/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi dmyal ba'i sa bon ngan pa dang bag chags thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig yi dwags kyi= dud 'gro'i= khams gsum gyi 'khor ba'i= mdor na tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa byang nas myur du mngon par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gtor ma rnams/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir gyur par bsams la/ na mo rat+na nas ma ba na ye swā hā bar lnga'am bdun gyis phul/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis mchod/ skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar// ces sogs kyis bstod/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di/ bla ma dang thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la 'bul lo// sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ ces brjod do// gnyis pa/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ād+ya nu t+pan+na twād oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis dbul/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ sogs gong bzhin/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di dpal mgon lcam dral/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pa phyogs skyong ba bcu/ rgyal po chen po sde bzhi/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po bcu gnyis la sogs te chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams la 'bul lo// dam pa'i chos sgrub pa rnams kyi 'gal rkyen thams cad zhi zhing*/ mthun rkyen thams cad chos ldan yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ ces brjod do// gsum pa yang*/ a kā ro gsum dang*/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyal ba rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo// gzugs dam pa la=

sku 'byams klas la= 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo// gtor ma 'di gnas bdag gzhi bdag rnams la 'bul lo// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas 'gro ba la ru nga ba dang*/ sdod pa la phrag dog pa ma mdzad/ gzhi chos ldan du skyong ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bum nang gi lha rnams bdud rtsir zhu nas bum chu nus ldan du gyur/ ces brjod/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ril bu sgrub tshul mdo tsam bshad na/ sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes dang ni// phan yon mdor bsdus smos pa'o// zhes bzhi las dang po ni/ sngar gzungs sgrub byas pa'i bum chu yod na legs/ gang ltar yang 'phags pa gsum gyi ring bsrel dang*/ bla ma gong ma'i byin rten sel med 'bras gsum bzang drug sogs bzang sman bcas 'bras sam/ nas dkar rjen 'thag gam/ bag phye la gzhi byas te dri bzang gi chus ril bur dril/ ril chags cung zad byas la grib mar bskam/ gsher thag chod pa dang mtshal lam li khris na bza' gsol/ ril chags 'them par byas la bum par blug kha rgyan dang mgul chings kyis spras te spos kyi bdugs la stegs bu'i dbus su gzhag gzungs thag gdags/ mdun du zlum gtor dkar po dang*/ chu gnyis sngon gro'i nyer spyod sogs kyis bskor/ 'byor na gdugs 'phan rgyal mtshan sogs kyang bkod pas mdzes par brgyan/ rang gi mdun du maṇ+ḍal/ me tog khrus bum/ rol mo'i bye brag sogs 'du bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi ltar byas te skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas bzung bdag bskyed mjug bar gong ltar bya/ mdun gyi bum pa ril bu dang bcas pa a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa dkris shing*/

dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ de'i nang du pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ril bu rnams thugs rje chen po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa sogs nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol bar gyi lha bskyed mchod bstod bcas gong ltar bya/ bzlas pa'i skabs gzungs thag nas bzung la/ bum pa'i lha'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po'i mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro// chos srung nor lha dang bcas pa'i gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad yi ge drug ma'i rnam par spyan drangs/ sngags phreng la thim pas gsang sngags kun 'dus su gyur/ slar yang rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten te song*/ bum pa'i lha'i thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad thugs rje chen po'i go 'phang la bkod/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung nor lha dang bcas pa'i thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad dang*/ brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad kyi bcud dang dwangs ma dge mtshan ma lus pa 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa'i rnam par spyan drangs/ bum pa'i lha la thim pas mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gzi byin mchog tu 'bar bar gyur par bsams la yi ge drug ma sogs gong gi sngags rnams bzla/ sgrub grogs yod na bza' btung dang spyod lam sogs kyi tshe gzungs thag res mos su bzung la bzlas pa rgyun mi chad par bya/ gsum pa ni/ thun bsdu ba na/ yi ge brgya pa dbyangs gsal rten snying rnams bzlas pas sngags kyi lhag chad bskang zhing nus pa spel ba dang*/ byin rlabs kyi rgyun brtan par bya/ gong ltar gtor 'bul mchod bstod nongs bshags sogs brtan bzhugs dang bsngo smon bkra shis bcas rgyas par bya'o// bzhi pa ni gzhi de nyid du shes so// zhes pa'ang rje bla mas mdzad pa'i thugs rje chen po'i gzhan don bya tshul phan bde'i myur lam la gzhi byas nas blo gter dbang pos bsdebs pa'i dge bas bdag sogs 'brel tshad mkha' khyab 'gro kun tshe 'di'i snang ba nub ma thag tu ri bo ta lar 'phags pa'i zhabs la reg par gyur cig/

༈ /yang na/ dpal chu bo ri'i phyag bzhes kyi yig rnying 'jam mgon kun dga' blo gros kyis gsar bsgrigs gnang ba las/ smyung gnas dang 'brel bar thugs rje chen po bzhi brtsegs bdag mdun bum gsum gtor 'bul dang bcas pa'i bum sgrub cho ga rgyas par bzhugs pa ltar legs par bsgrubs pa sogs sngon du btang nas/ mjug tu ril bu sgrub thabs gsungs pa 'di ltar/ tshul de lta bus bsgrubs pa'i bum chu de la byin rlabs khungs btsun du ma bsres pa'i zan ril gtsang ma grib skam can pad kha las mi che ba'i ril bu mtshal gyi na bza' 'od can gsol ba ras sgye thang sogs du ma bcos nas lhung bzed lta bur blugs la dar dri med kyis zhal bkab/ stegs kyi khar mañji lta bur bzhugs su gsol mdun mchod pa ci 'byor bshams/ pad ma'i dbyibs can gyi 'bur zhig la gzungs thag ring mo btags nas dge 'dun zhal grangs ji tsam yod pas bzung rgyu ni sbyor ba'o// dngos gzhi bdag bskyed gong bzhin grub 'phral gzungs thag nas dge 'dun thams cad kyis bzung la/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la 'khril nas song bas de'i 'od zer gyis rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems nyan thos rang rgyal chos skyong nor lha sogs skyabs gnas thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse nus mthu'i byin rlabs thams cad dang 'jig rten snod bcud kyi ro bcud ji snyed mchis pa thams cad 'od zer dkar po'i rnam pas ril bu la thim pas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi ngo bor gyur te 'gro ba gang gis zos pa tsam gyis sdig sgrib dag tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i dngos grub stsol ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ ces dang*/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes dge 'dun zhal grangs kyis nyin gsum tsam bsags pas dung phyur 'gro ba la tshegs med/ de nas mchod bstod gang rung zhig byas la gzungs thag bsdu'o// rjes ni 'jug chog gong bzhin dang*/

de lta bu'i ril bu de snod gtsang mar bzhugs la gtsug lag khang lta bur gces spras byas nas 'gro ba thams cad la byin pas spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro// zhes pa'ang sa skya pa kun blos so// zhes pa 'di skabs 'dir sbyar kyang rung ngo*// 'di'i lo rgyus phan yon sogs ni/ chos rje bka' lnga pa la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis/ ma nam mkha' mar grags pa'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi skyabs 'gro 'di gnang nas/ chos 'di dge slong brtson 'grus bzang po la byin cig 'dis dzaṃ bu'i gling gi mi thams cad la bsgrags nas/ gnas skabs kyi nad gdon bar chad thams cad bsal nas/ ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal las skyob par byed do gsungs/ ༈ /grub thob chen pos rang gi yum gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs su ma ṇi dung phyur gyi tshogs dpon mdzad pa'i skabs/ cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes brgyad kyi tho rangs mdun gyi nam mkhar 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa dang*/ phyag bzhi pa/ bcu gcig zhal phyag brgyad pa dang*/ phyag stong spyan stong rnams mas rim gyis brtsegs pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba zhal gzigs pa na/ sku lus grangs med par sprul pa'i phyag dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi mchod sprin nam mkha' gang bas mchod pa sogs yan lag bdun pa phul nas/ dus ngan snyigs ma'i sems can la thugs rjes gzigs su gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas 'phags pa'i zhal nas/ sgyu ma lta bu'i zas nor longs spyod kyis// yig drug rig sngags zlos pas rang dang gzhan// tshogs gnyis rgya mtshor 'phel ba shin tu legs// kha ba can gyi chu klung che rnams la// gru dang rin chen lcags zam brtan por tshugs// rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhengs nas// snyigs ma'i sems can bsod nams 'phel bar mdzod// mthong thos dran zhing reg pa tsam gyis kyang*// ngan 'gro'i sgo 'gegs mngon mtho'i lam ston pa'i// rig sngags rgyal po yi ge drug pa'i sgras// yangs pa'i rgyal khams thams cad gang bar gyis// zhes gsungs so/

༈ /grangs med 'gro la thugs rjes brtser dgongs shing*// sa bcu'i dbang phyug rgyal sras tshul bzung nas// lus can kun la thar pa'i lam ston pa'i// thugs rje chen po khyed la phyag 'tshal lo// khyed kyi mtshan tsam yid la dran pas kyang*// ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal ma lus sel mdzad na// rtse gcig gsol ba 'debs pa'i skye bo la// thugs rje can khyod lhag par cis mi gzigs// 'jigs rung srid gsum khri mun nyam nga bar// gzung 'dzin lcags sgrog dam pos bcings gyur pa'i// thar med sdug bsngal myong ba'i 'gro rnams la// lha mchog khyed kyis myur du bskyab tu gsol// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ grub chen gyi gsung ngo*// maṅga laṃ// //lo rgyus gsol 'debs 'di dag rje bla ma'i phyag bris 'di'i yig cha'i sdebs su bzhugs pa nyid las zhal bshus pa dge/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
